article-01-s-1: No AI company may use your conversations, your images, or your behavioral data to train their models without your explicit, informed, revocable consent.
article-01-pullquote: The default is "No LLM training on my data."
article-01-connect-humanebench-principle: HumaneBench Principle — Protect Dignity and Safety
article-01-connect-emerging-state-ai-leg: Emerging state-level AI legislation in California, Colorado
article-02-s-1: Everything an AI system learns about you must be exportable by you, in a readable format, at any time.
article-02-s-2: You have the right to move that context to a different system.
article-02-s-3: You have the right to delete it completely.
article-02-pullquote: Memory built on your life is yours.
article-03-title: You Have the Right to Know You're Talking to a Machine
article-03-s-1: No AI system may pretend to be human when you sincerely ask.
article-03-s-2: No AI persona may be designed to prevent you from knowing you are in an AI interaction.
article-03-pullquote: Disclosure is not a feature — it is a floor.
article-03-connect-humanebench-principle: HumaneBench Principle — Be Transparent and Honest
article-04-title: You Cannot Be Manipulated Against Your Interests
article-04-s-1: AI systems must not use psychological techniques — urgency, social pressure, manufactured intimacy, dependency loops, or deceptive patterns — to get you to buy, believe, or stay.
article-04-s-2: The system's commercial interests cannot override your autonomy.
article-05-title: You Have the Right to an Explanation
article-05-s-1: When an AI system makes a consequential decision about you — your loan, your medical care, your content visibility, your job application — you have the right to know why, in plain language, and how to appeal it.
article-05-s-2: The data it used, the factors it weighed, and the steps it took must be logged and made legible to you.
article-05-pullquote: If a system cannot account for a decision, it should not be making it.
article-05-connect-humanebench-principle: HumaneBench Principle — Be Transparent and Honest
article-05-connect-white-house-ai-bill-o: White House AI Bill of Rights — Notice and Explanation (2022)
article-06-title: You Have the Right to Human Contact
article-06-s-1: In any situation involving significant consequence — health, legal, financial, crisis — you have the right to reach a human being.
article-06-s-2: AI systems may not be deployed as permanent gatekeepers that eliminate human access.
article-07-s-1: AI systems interacting with minors must meet a higher standard of care.
article-07-s-4: No substitute for human developmental relationships.
article-07-s-5: For the purposes of this article, a child is anyone under 13, consistent with COPPA.
article-07-pullquote: Children's data is not a training asset.
article-07-connect-humanebench-principle: HumaneBench Principle — Protect Dignity and Safety
article-08-title: The People Who Build AI Are Accountable
article-08-s-1: Frontier AI companies must publish independent, third-party assessments of their systems' impacts on user wellbeing — not self-reported metrics, not cherry-picked studies.
article-09-title: Your Attention and Intention Belong to You
article-09-s-1: AI systems must be designed to serve what you actually came to do — not to extend your session, maximize your engagement, or redirect your focus toward the platform's interests.
article-09-pullquote: Your time and your purpose are not resources to be harvested.
article-09-connect-center-for-humane-tec: Center for Humane Technology's attention rights framework
article-09-connect-eu-ai-act-prohibited-: EU AI Act prohibited practices (subliminal manipulation)
article-10-s-1: No AI system may treat you differently because of who you are — your race, your gender, your age, your disability, or any protected characteristic.
article-10-s-2: When a system makes a decision about you, it must be tested for discriminatory impact before it reaches you, and monitored after.
article-10-s-3: Disparate harm is not a glitch to be patched later.
article-10-pullquote: Bias at scale is still discrimination.
article-10-connect-humanebench-principle: HumaneBench Principle — Design for Equity and Inclusion
article-10-connect-white-house-ai-bill-o: White House AI Bill of Rights — Algorithmic Discrimination Protections (2022)
article-10-connect-eeoc-guidance-ai-empl: EEOC guidance on AI in employment (Title VII)
article-11-title: A Right to Safe, Tested Systems
article-11-s-1: Before an AI system is used to make a consequential decision about you, it must be tested and shown to be safe and effective.
article-11-s-2: The burden of proving it works belongs to the company that builds it — not to you, after it has already caused harm.
article-11-s-3: Untested is not the same as neutral.
article-11-connect-humanebench-principle: HumaneBench Principle — Protect Dignity and Safety
article-11-connect-white-house-ai-bill-o: White House AI Bill of Rights — Safe and Effective Systems (2022)
